rules.percentile: 基础指标日前向 3 年，同一来源样本数 >= 20 且跨度 >= 180 天；基础指标超过 7 天标 STALE，基础指标或历史冲突/存疑时不产生当前分位
rules.effectivePrice: MANUAL_PRICE > 当日 REALTIME_PRICE > CLOSE_PRICE / OFFICIAL_NAV
rules.pe: 指数优先中证官方滚动 PE；官方未覆盖时保留报价端 pe，并标记 SUSPECT；官方与报价跨日期/口径比较为 NOT_COMPARABLE
rules.sources: Touzid 仅用于字段结构参考，不写入本地真实数值；本脚本不发起外部请求
rules.missing: 没有逐字段请求证据时使用 MISSING，不由代码前缀或缺值推断网络故障/无公开来源
rules.ytd: 使用距上一年 12 月 31 日不超过 14 天的最近有效价作为基准，排除 REALTIME_PRICE、CONFLICT、MISSING；缺基准时不计算
rules.roe: 固定前 3 / 2 / 1 个日历年末次 ROE 观测，缺年留 null；观测年不等同财报年度
rules.close: 北京时间 15:00 前的当日 K 线不得写入 CLOSE_PRICE
rules.latestMetrics: 列出每个已存 metric_key 的最新非未来记录，保留原文、数值、日期、来源、质量及状态；主展示 PE 仍按官方优先口径选择，两者选择依据不同
rules.rawData: 遍历全部 valuation_metrics 和 market_data 行；scale_info 按总市值文本解析，其余估值键按有限数值校验；行情值必须正且有限；逐行核查日历、未来日期、质量和误标收盘价
rules.validState: VALID 只表示本地结构与已定义校验规则通过，不等于已逐笔向外部重新核实
rules.validMeaning: VALID 表示通过本地结构及已声明规则，不等于所有来源均已独立证实。来源核验范围单列 sourceVerification。
rules.unsupportedMeaning: UNSUPPORTED 仅表示当前项目未接入或未建模，不代表外部数据不存在。

rules.sourceEvidence: Each raw response must match its manifest SHA-256, HTTP 200 and JSON code 200.
rules.history: Compare each raw official positive PE row by active INDEX code and Gregorian date against provider csindex, key pe; also check database-only official PE rows.
rules.snapshot: Match each official name to exactly one active local INDEX; peg -> pe, pe -> pe_official_static, pb -> pb, dp -> dividend_yield.
rules.numeric: PE/PB/PS and prices must be finite and positive; dividend yield and turnover nonnegative; percentile within [0,100]. Text scale_info is parsed as positive market capitalization, not cast with Number().
rules.percentile: Same-day positive base, official-only PE when an official series exists, trailing 3 calendar years, at least 20 samples and 180 days, no CONFLICT bases; 100 * count(x<=current) / n rounded to 2 decimals. Latest bases older than 7 days cannot support current percentiles.
rules.limits: This audit verifies every saved official response against storage. It does not independently prove all quotation prices or unsupported valuation fields, and does not infer missing observations.

xlsEvidence.extraction: Raw OLE/BIFF files were parsed with the project parser during evidence collection; source hashes and database comparisons are checked here independently.
xlsEvidence.limits: Only the eight cached XLS files (160 instrument-days) are re-fetched original source evidence. Other archived dividend rows retain the prior adapter mapping and companion-key lineage, which is not an independent original-source value verification.
